caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden cabinet viewed at an angle, with its left side and front visible. The cabinet is light brown with darker brown and black ink or paint used for detailed decorations. The front and visible side panels are adorned with detailed artwork: the front displays scenes with trees, deer, and birds, arranged in three rectangular sections vertically, each separated by a thin line, while the side and top panels are decorated with various floral and leafy motifs as well as a beehive shape. The cabinet has two black metal hinges visible on the left edge where the door would open. The background is an unadorned, off-white or beige paper, emphasizing the cabinet as the sole object in the composition.
title: Cupboard
